title: shark~

arguments.description: frequency in MIDI pitch or Hz

flags.name: -midi
flags.description: sets frequency input in MIDI pitch (default Hz)

flags.name: -soft
flags.description: sets to soft sync mode (default hard)

methods.description: nonzero sets to frequency input in MIDI pitch
nonzero sets to soft sync mode

body: [shark~] is a sharktooth waveform oscillator abstraction. Based on a Moog oscillator, this is a hybrid (and a mix) between a sawtooth and a triangular wave. This is a bandlimited oscillator that accepts negative frequencies, has inlets for phase sync and phase modulation and support for multichannels.
